mechanism: Both drugs increase CNS stimulation and have additive effects on the nervous system; pregabalin enhances GABAergic inhibition while lisdexamfetamine (amphetamine) provides sympathomimetic stimulation, creating opposing but potentially problematic CNS effects.
action: Monitor for excessive CNS depression or paradoxical stimulation; assess seizure threshold and cardiac effects; consider dose adjustment or alternative therapy if signs of significant CNS effects occur.
